subject: 🔁 Follow-up inspection scheduled - $building_name Room $room_number on $follow_up_date
body:
Dear $student_name,

A follow-up inspection of your room has been scheduled. This is because the previous inspection could not be signed off yet — the reason is set out below.

=== WHY A FOLLOW-UP IS NEEDED ===
$follow_up_reason

=== NEW INSPECTION DATE ===
Follow-Up Date: $follow_up_date
Building: $building_name
Room Number: $room_number
Floor Number: $floor_number
Inspector: $inspector_name
Inspection Type: $inspection_type

=== THE ORIGINAL INSPECTION ===
Inspection Reference: $inspection_id
Original Date: $inspection_date
Status: $status

Findings recorded at the time:
$findings

Action required from you:
$action_required

=== WHAT YOU NEED TO DO BEFORE THE FOLLOW-UP ===
1. Address each of the points under 'Action required' above.
2. Make sure the room is accessible on the follow-up date.
3. If you need help — a repair, a replacement, or more time — contact the Housing Office before the date rather than after it.

=== IF THE DATE DOES NOT WORK ===
Contact the Housing Office as soon as possible and we will try to rearrange. Not being present does not stop the inspection going ahead.

=== CONTACT INFORMATION ===
Housing Office: housing@university.edu
Phone: (555) 123-4567
Office Hours: Monday-Friday, 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM

Best regards,
University Housing Administration

$signature

follow_up_reason.default: The inspection needs to be repeated.
